name: Sector ETF Performance in High vs Low Inflation Regimes
description: Identifies high-inflation periods (CPI YoY > 4% via CPIAUCSL) and compares monthly performance of XLE, XLK, XLF, and XLP sector ETFs across regimes. Summary table shows N, avg return, median return, hit rate, and annualized return per regime. Cumulative return line chart shades high-inflation periods and marks regime entry points with event markers.
source:
# Sector ETF Performance: High vs Low Inflation Regimes
# Regime: CPI YoY (CPIAUCSL) > 4% = High Inflation, <= 4% = Low Inflation
# Monthly returns aligned to monthly CPI cadence
# Summary table: N, Avg, Median, Hit Rate, Annualized per regime (standard mode, 5x2 grid)
# Cumulative chart: shaded high-inflation bands + regime-entry event markers

# ─── DATA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Primary ETF price (one per asset context: XLE, XLK, XLF, XLP)
src = market_data_source()()

# CPI: CPIAUCSL monthly index levels — ffill to daily so regime is always defined
cpi_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='CPIAUCSL')()
cpi_daily = ffill(cpi_raw.result)

# ─── MONTHLY AGGREGATION ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Downsample ETF close and CPI to monthly bars (last value of each month)
close_monthly = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(src.c)
cpi_monthly   = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(cpi_daily)

# Monthly ETF returns (simple, period=1 on monthly bars = 1 month)
ret_monthly = returns(period=1)(close_monthly)

# CPI YoY: 12-month return on monthly CPI levels (decimal, e.g. 0.08 = 8%)
cpi_yoy = returns(period=12)(cpi_monthly)

# ─── REGIME CLASSIFICATION ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

# High inflation flag: CPI YoY > 4%
is_high_inflation = is_valid(cpi_yoy) and cpi_yoy > 0.04

# Low inflation flag: CPI YoY available but <= 4%
is_low_inflation = is_valid(cpi_yoy) and cpi_yoy <= 0.04

# ─── PER-REGIME FILTERED SERIES (for standard-mode summary table) ────────────

# Hit rate helper: 1.0 if monthly return positive, else 0.0
hit_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(ret_monthly) and ret_monthly > 0.0) else 0.0

# Annualized return per bar: (1 + monthly_ret)^12 - 1
ann_ret = (1.0 + ret_monthly) ** 12 - 1.0

# High-inflation regime series (NaN outside regime)
ret_hi  = where(is_high_inflation, ret_monthly)
hit_hi  = where(is_high_inflation, hit_flag)
ann_hi  = where(is_high_inflation, ann_ret)

# Low-inflation regime series (NaN outside regime)
ret_lo  = where(is_low_inflation, ret_monthly)
hit_lo  = where(is_low_inflation, hit_flag)
ann_lo  = where(is_low_inflation, ann_ret)

# ─── CUMULATIVE RETURN (daily, for the line chart) ──────────────────────────

# Daily returns for cumulative equity curve
ret_daily = returns(period=1)(src.c)

# Cumulative return product: starts at 1.0
cum_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1.0 + ret_daily)

# High-inflation band signal on daily bars (1.0 = high inflation, 0.0 = low)
# Compute monthly flag then ffill to daily
is_hi_monthly_float = 1.0 if is_high_inflation else 0.0
infl_band_daily = ffill(is_hi_monthly_float)

# ─── EVENT MARKER: Start of each new high-inflation episode ─────────────────

# Crossover from low to high inflation (episode start)
infl_episode_start = crossover(infl_band_daily, 0.5)

# CPI YoY and ETF price on episode start day (for event card)
cpi_yoy_daily = ffill(cpi_yoy)
cpi_at_start   = where(infl_episode_start, cpi_yoy_daily)
close_at_start = where(infl_episode_start, src.c)

# ─── INDEX FOR X-AXIS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

idx = index()()

# ─── OUTPUT 1: SUMMARY TABLE (standard mode, 5 rows × 2 columns) ─────────────
# Row 0: N (count of months)
# Row 1: Avg Monthly Return
# Row 2: Median Monthly Return
# Row 3: Hit Rate (% months positive)
# Row 4: Annualized Return
# Col 0: High Inflation (>4%), Col 1: Low Inflation (≤4%)
# Inputs positionally: ret_hi, ret_lo, hit_hi, hit_lo, ann_hi, ann_lo, ret_hi, ret_lo, ann_hi, ann_lo

summary_table(
    category='Inflation Regime Analysis',
    order=1,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Monthly Return Statistics by Inflation Regime',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Months (N)', 'Avg Monthly Return', 'Median Monthly Return', 'Hit Rate (% Months Positive)', 'Annualized Return'],
        col_headers=['High Inflation (>4% YoY)', 'Low Inflation (≤4% YoY)'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: N (count of non-null months per regime)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 1: Avg Monthly Return
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 2: Median Monthly Return
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 3: Hit Rate (mean of 0/1 flag = fraction positive)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 4: Annualized Return
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(ret_hi, ret_lo, ret_hi, ret_lo, hit_hi, hit_lo, ann_hi, ann_lo, ann_hi, ann_lo)

# ─── OUTPUT 2: CUMULATIVE RETURN LINE CHART WITH INFLATION SHADING ───────────

xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Return with High-Inflation Periods Shaded (CPI YoY >4%)',
    category='Inflation Regime Analysis',
    order=2,
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return (1.0 = Start)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title='Starting Value', color=Color.Gray,
                      dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='High Inflation (CPI YoY >4%)', color=Color.Red,
                       is_band=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative Return', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(infl_band_daily, cum_ret))

# ─── OUTPUT 3: EVENT MARKER — High-Inflation Episode Starts ─────────────────

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='High Inflation Episode Start',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='CPI YoY at Entry', dp=1,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='ETF Price', dp=2,
                       type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(cpi_at_start, close_at_start, infl_episode_start)
